signedOut: Log in to see your support requests. Without an account, use the Contact us form.

list.title: Your support requests
list.intro: Ask our support team for help with your account, writing, reading or anything else. A person answers every request.
list.empty: You haven’t asked for help yet.
list.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your requests. Check your connection and try again.

new.title: Ask for help
new.intro: Tell us what happened. Please don’t include passwords or someone else’s private details.
new.safety: If someone is in danger right now, call 112. To report something you saw here, use Report on it instead.
new.subject: Subject
new.sent: Sent. Your request is #{{number}}. We’ll answer you here.

ticket.closed: This request is closed. If you need more help, ask again and mention #{{number}}.
ticket.notFound: We couldn’t find this request on your account.
ticket.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this request. Check your connection and try again.

failures.too_many: You’ve sent a lot of requests in the last hour. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
failures.not_found: We couldn’t find this request on your account.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t send it. Check your connection and try again.

settings.heading: Your support requests
settings.intro: Ask our support team for help and read their answers in one place.

staff.heading: Support tickets
staff.intro: Every request from email, Contact us and the app, as one numbered ticket. Answers go out from the support team; internal notes stay with staff.
staff.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the tickets. Try again in a moment.
staff.notAllowed: Only support staff can read support tickets.
staff.notFound: There is no ticket with this number.

fields.heading: Ticket
fields.assigneeHint: A support team member’s username, or empty for nobody.
fields.tagsHint: Lower-case words, separated by commas: for example drafts, login.
fields.failed: We couldn’t save this. Check the username and the tags, then try again.

requester.heading: Who is asking
requester.emailOnly: Email only: no account uses this address.
requester.emailHint: Showing the address is written in the audit log.
requester.emailFailed: We couldn’t show the email. Try again in a moment.

under16.title: This person is under 16
under16.body: Answer only in this ticket, never by private message. Keep your words simple and kind, and ask for no more personal details than you need. If they might be at risk, tell the safeguarding team straight away.

messages.label: Messages
messages.note: Internal note by @{{handle}} (only staff see this)

reply.label: Answer the person, or add a note
reply.closed: This ticket is closed: you can add notes, not answers.

canned.heading: Canned replies
canned.intro: Ready answers to insert into a ticket and edit before sending. {{name}} becomes the person’s name and {{number}} the ticket’s number, in the ticket’s language.
canned.inserted: “{{title}}” is in the box: check it and edit it before sending.
